title: Juicy Lazy Slovakian Kabanos Platter
description: A comforting, umami-rich dish perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. The combination of Polish kabanos, dashi extract, and savory vegetables creates a satisfying and filling meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and sauté for 5-6 minutes, until they release their liquid and start browning.
Add the Polish kabanos to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Add the dashi extract, soy sauce (if using), black pepper, and salt. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the kabanos are crispy and the vegetables are well coated with the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (optional).
